lockup.summary: The company, its directors, its officers and anyone holding 5% or more of the shares agreed not to sell for 180 days after the offering closes. The lead underwriter may ask smaller holders to sign the same agreement.

what: It runs a Hong Kong school that teaches investing and stock trading to individual investors, in classrooms and online.
proceeds: It plans to use the money to expand abroad, upgrade its IT systems, add more courses, and improve its teaching and management tools. The rest would go to working capital and general company needs.
risks: The business relies on its Hao Feng brand, and anything that harms its reputation or customer trust could hurt sales.
It faces tough competition in Hong Kong from rivals that may have more money, bigger reach and lower prices.
If its course quality slips, customers may cancel, complain or bring claims, which could cost it money and reputation.
Its investing lessons and content could be treated as investment advice, which could bring legal liability, fines or other regulatory action.
It sells its courses through online channels that it does not fully control.
